independent_recalculation.method: KKT block linear system for saved positive support, then nonnegative dual-residual and positive-definite Hessian checks
independent_recalculation.sufficient_optimality_reason: The positive-definite covariance makes the objective strictly convex on the simplex. Primal feasibility, equality stationarity on positive weights and nonnegative inactive reduced gradients establish the unique constrained minimum to the stated numerical tolerance.

primary_paper_review.inspection: Fresh official arXiv page read and preserved prior HTML bound by SHA.
primary_paper_review.supported: The paper uses uniform allocation and long-only minimum variance as classical comparators; covariance strategies use common trailing returns and 252-day annualization.
primary_paper_review.adaptation: This audit approves their formulas on the frozen eleven-sector data only. It does not import the paper's multi-asset eligibility, replay, costs, investor profiles, outcome ranking or stage gold scores.

topic_connection: References expose the allocation produced by simple transparent numerical rules. They cannot interpret institution prose or the supplied macro context, so the common-context AI C arm supplies the appropriate task-level comparison while these remain arithmetic/risk references.
claims_allowed: Equal weight is uniform over the eleven supplied sectors.
GMV is the minimum-variance long-only portfolio for this particular past-window sample covariance.
Distances to these references describe allocations; they are not source-fidelity scores.
claims_not_allowed: This is the optimal investment for the common capital-appreciation objective.
This vector recovers Fidelity or UBS strategy.
Lower in-sample volatility establishes future superiority or lower actual realized risk.
1/N or GMV replaces the C control or proves a causal effect of institutional information.
scope_limitations: The saved sample covariance was checked for identity and units; no new market data were downloaded.
The parent separately enumerated 2047 faces and ran SLSQP; this reviewer independently checked the saved solution with a different KKT formulation.
Source review and computation review are AI-assisted, with no fabricated human approval.
Solver tolerances are engineering precision conventions and not behavioral or investment thresholds.
